items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] (Eric Partridge?) gives that kind of derivation in an entymological dictionary.

ctx.x: Jazz, the word jazz, originally before I ever heard the word jazz applied to music meant, pelvic action. Like you're jazzing. Jazzing, meaning you jazz. So it meant a pelvic motion so......
(Eric Partridge?) gives that kind of derivation in an entymological dictionary.
What it really means is a dance form in a sense. Do you know what I mean? Like a dance. We still have dances all the time, they just don't last as long as the word jazz does.
